ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to Information Systems & Information Technology, Supply Chain Management and Management students on Monday, April 20, 2015 at approximately 9:00 a.m and to all College of Business Students on Monday, April 27, 2015 at approximately 9:00 a.m. There are currently 5 reserved seats for College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, August 28, 2015 at approximately 9:00 a.m.
